name: Keyideas Jewelry Configurator
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Keyideas Jewelry Configurator helps jewelry stores offer an interactive 3D configuration experience for rings and bracelets inside WordPress and WooCommerce.

After activation, the plugin creates a configurator page and adds an admin dashboard where you can access the experience, review your setup, and manage the plugin workflow.

Customers can move through a guided step-by-step flow and preview supported products in real time. The configurator is designed to support core jewelry personalization options such as metal selection, stone choice, sizing, and engraving, depending on your store setup.

Features:

  • Automatic configurator page creation on activation
  • WordPress admin dashboard for plugin access and setup
  • Interactive 3D product preview workflow
  • Ring and bracelet configuration support
  • WooCommerce-oriented custom product experience
  • Mobile-friendly customer journey

The plugin includes a default setup to help you get started. Additional configuration, custom model onboarding, and advanced commerce workflows may depend on your project implementation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Keyideas Jewelry Configurator from the Plugins screen.
  3. After activation, the plugin automatically creates the configurator page used for the storefront experience.
  4. In the WordPress admin menu, open the Jewelry Configurator dashboard.
  5. Review the generated page and add it to your website navigation if you want customers to access it directly.
  6. Use the plugin dashboard to review the setup and continue with your configurator workflow.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin create a page automatically?

Yes. On activation, the plugin creates a configurator page so you can start reviewing the experience immediately.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

The plugin is intended for WordPress stores that use WooCommerce for the custom jewelry buying flow.

Can I use my own jewelry models?

The plugin includes a default setup to get started. Custom model support and advanced configuration workflows depend on your implementation setup.
